camera.description: Fixed elevated oblique medium two-shot looking down toward the low wall and sponge contact. No camera movement.

start_state: Roshan holds the star sponge just away from one bounded brown-gray smear. Rumi presents one open hand ready to dampen the sponge. No window is in this part of the hall. Collected paper is secured offscreen between shots, not back on the floor.
end_state: Smear transfers to the sponge during contact; Roshan lifts it away. Rumi's small water stream has stopped, the original wall is clean and dry, no puddle or color change.
zone: B-middle, low wall/molding between pool droplet and bath three-pearl doors
must_move: Rumi directs a thin short water thread into Roshan's sponge, never across the room. Roshan presses the sponge against the bounded smear and wipes once along its width; only the touched dirt transfers to the sponge. Rumi stops the water before Roshan lifts the visibly dirt-marked sponge; reveal the original intact molding and wall with no puddle.
must_not_move: Fixed screen-B topology: teddy, palette, single blue droplet, three pearls, then open Royal arch with short stairs, left to right; never a coral window on B
Same warm pearl/lavender storybook grade; architecture, emblems, runner and staircase never move or recolor
Roshan plain pink top/lavender tail; Daddy continuous rainbow mer-tail and glasses; Rumi long purple braid/mer-tail; Eagle true bird; no new costumes or limbs

Rainbow friend retains the source cloud-mound, broad spiral ears, red-orange forehead curl, white iridescent glint and pearl feet; total height at same floor depth no more than one quarter of Roshan, pending owner scale approval
Remove only inert litter, webs, wall smears and footprints; living puff creatures are never swept or blasted; no big boss remains
Cleaned zones remain clean; preserve dirt until shown physical contact removes it; no whole-room magical cleanup
sound_intent: A quiet trickle, soft sponge wipe, then dry room tone; no dialogue or music.
negative_constraints: No screen-A window, generic arch replacing pool/bath signs, flood, whole-wall repaint, sponge morph, hand/contact gap, vanished sponge, new costume, giant splash or grime returning.
